steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each asset is placed by its end-of-support date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 asset is past end of support

findings.title: Past end of support and still in service
findings.fix: Replace it or plan the replacement now

findings.title: Critical asset with no replacement plan
findings.fix: Write a replacement plan with a date

outcome.notChecked: Whether the replacement will fit the workload.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] asset-server-old-4:12  Past end of support and still in service.
       Fix: Replace it or plan the replacement now.
[medium] asset-fw-2019:19  Critical asset with no replacement plan.
       Fix: Write a replacement plan with a date.
[low] asset-ups-9:26  Replacement cost with no source.
       Fix: Attach the quote.
Not checked: Whether the replacement will fit the workload.
pros: Flags an asset past its end of support in service, a critical asset with no replacement plan, and a cost with no source.
cons: Not checked: Whether the replacement will fit the workload.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-hardware-refresh-plan skill on the records for this review.
